cross_dataset_leakage.leakage_finding: Dedicated datasets (Guava SAU, BananaID, Apple Mendeley, Harumanis) share ZERO exact SHA-256 images with FruitNet. Dedicated datasets and FruitNet are completely disjoint.
cross_dataset_leakage.fruitnet_burst_cluster_warning: Verified strong burst clustering in FruitNet (20 near-dupes per 500-sample window). FruitNet data cannot be split randomly; burst sessions must stay grouped.

synchronization_guarantees.guava_test_split_locked: Stage 1 test split contains exactly the 345 Guava images from v2_grouped/test.json with ZERO leakage into Stage 1 train or val.
synchronization_guarantees.banana_test_split_locked: Stage 1 test split contains exactly the 297 Banana images from banana_ripeness/test.json with ZERO leakage into Stage 1 train or val.
synchronization_guarantees.apple_test_split_locked: Stage 1 test split contains exactly the 409 Apple crops from apple_crops_v1/test.json with ZERO leakage into Stage 1 train or val.
synchronization_guarantees.negative_pool_isolation: Negative samples are partitioned by capture burst group ID to eliminate visual leakage across train, val, and test.

guava.dataset_name: Guava Classification Dataset (Local Sindhi, Riyali, Thadhrami)
guava.source: Sindh Agriculture University / Local Orchard Harvest
guava.commercial_use: Restricted to internal research & non-commercial pilot deployment
guava.label_independence: IMPLICIT. 100% of images are Guava (*Psidium guajava*). Labeled attributes are Cultivar (3) and Maturity (3). Valid for Stage 1 fruit identity.

banana.dataset_name: BananaID: An image dataset of banana varieties and ripeness stages in Indonesia
banana.label_independence: IMPLICIT. 100% of images are Banana (*Musa acuminata/balbisiana*). Two orthogonal label axes: Variety (5) and Ripeness (4). Valid for Stage 1 fruit identity.

apple.authors: Dandan Wang, Bo Wang (Data in Brief, June 2026)
apple.commercial_use: STRICTLY NON-COMMERCIAL. Production enterprise deployment requires commercial licensing agreement or substitution with CC-BY / public domain apple dataset.
apple.label_independence: IMPLICIT. Crops extracted strictly from verified polygon masks. Labeled attributes are Phenotyping maturity stages. Valid for Stage 1 fruit identity.

mango.label_independence: IMPLICIT. 100% of images are Harumanis Mango (*Mangifera indica*). Labeled attributes are Maturity/Pathology (4 classes).
mango.readiness_gate: BLOCKED FOR PRODUCTION TRAINING. Volume of 272 images (Rotten=23) is statistically underpowered. Must remain non-production until supplemented.

fruitnet.label_independence: EXPLICIT. Top-level folders explicitly name fruit identity (Apple, Banana, Guava, Orange, Lime, Pomegranate).
fruitnet.suitability_assessment: Suitable as supplemental data and OUT-OF-DISTRIBUTION (OOD) negative evaluation pool (Orange, Lime/Lemon, Pomegranate).

decisions.mango_production_status: BLOCKED (272 samples only; awaiting data acquisition)
decisions.apple_licensing_constraint: FLAGGED (CC BY-NC 4.0; non-commercial research use only)
